# P3: Later starts and grades in a district trial

Citation: Marlow, K., & Eze, T. (2019). Journal of Adolescent Schooling, 14(2), 55-71.
Type: controlled trial (n = 4,100 students, six schools)

Abstract: Three schools moved their first lesson from 08:15 to 09:10 for one year, and three kept 08:15. Students at the later-start schools slept 34 minutes longer on school nights, and their average grades rose by 6 per cent against the other three schools.

My notes: The strongest evidence for grades so far.
